g.text: UC-005 System Sequence Diagram — Phone List Coordination (PIM)
View Phone List for Active Shift
The system's internal structure is NOT shown here.
No services, no managers, no repositories.
- NO HTTP, NO JSON, NO REST verbs
- NO async/Task — those are platform constructs
System Time Event is an internal actor (Rule M1):
It represents the system's capability to react to time.
In CIM there is no such actor.
